scope: Cindy/Synara comparison and selected locally runnable complements. This registry does not claim all reference commits were integrated.
reviewLevel: Every commit topic and changed path classified; focused implementation diffs reviewed for metadata, IM wake, loop guard, worktree, turn ownership, idle reaper, crash recovery and FIFO. No claim of full line-by-line review of unrelated UI/cloud code.

validation.localBehavior: 208 focused behavior tests passed: Codex live 92, Claude live 41, registry 22, IM origin 1, IM owner 1, metadata TypeScript 51. The additional Codex start-reply race and native wake ownership regressions were observed RED then GREEN.
validation.nativeMetadata: Main crate cargo test local_ai::tests --lib: 15 passed, including nested input/output modality and client protocol precedence.
validation.appWiring: Verified in source: App.tsx binds accepted IM turns with ownerId and actual workCwd before sendHarnessTurn; clears origin for desktop turns; subscriber checks current harness/worktree and busy state, sends original channel/session with expectedOwnerId. ModelConnections.tsx discovery calls mergeDiscoveredModelMetadata. TSC --noEmit passed after implementation.
validation.inlineHTML: Chromium2 and WebKit2 real browser cases passed for native CSP/bootstrap and parent-approved frozen external links. WebKit used static fixture preview after Vite dev module timeout. Unit4 passed. No signed Tauri WebView IPC/device claim.
validation.fifo: Existing metadata.is_file guards confirmed. New directory regression and Unix mkfifo non-blocking regression exist in fs.rs. Unix execution awaits Linux CI; no claim that Unix FIFO testing passed.
validation.IMWakeConcurrency: Fixed with RED then GREEN: reject explicit send while provider wake owns result; bind origin lease per accepted turn; cancellation stops stale transport; only provider-authored start/content and completed/success final publish. Six focused files 125 tests passed; independent spec passed; real IM account not executed.
